ruling: ADR_UGENCE_AUTHORITY_PLANE_SCOPING.md AP-5 READS_FIRST (step 3: the front-end shell over the four reads); section 16 AW-1 GATED_WRITES_BEFORE_ISSUER_VALIDATION, AW-2 DIRECTORY_WRITES_ONLY, AW-3 PROOF_PRESENTED_PER_WRITE_NEVER_STORED (the two grant writes behind the identity gate)
notes: This app may consume the four AP-5 reads and the two directory writes the worker's contract marks served, and nothing else. A write is sent only with the token the operator presented for the session, on write_proof_header, never on a read, never stored (AW-3). The two unserved writes, activate and issue, are named here as forbidden so a later step cannot add one without changing this file and the worker's contract together (AW-2). scripts/verify-boundary.mjs checks this file against the worker's committed contract and against the client's real call sites, by method.
